title: Fall of Agadir
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Fall of Agadir", at revision 1370617677, opens: "The Fall of Agadir refers to the conquest of the city in Morocco by the Saadians against the Portuguese in 1541." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q5432140, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1541 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
